questions.prompt: Let x be a unitless number. Its domain is integers from -1 through 7, inclusive. Condition: ((x - 3) * (x - 3)) < 9. How many integers in this domain satisfy the condition?
Let x be a unitless number. Its domain is integers from 3 through 11, inclusive. Condition: ((x - 7) * (x - 7)) < 9. How many integers in this domain satisfy the condition?
Let x be a unitless number. Its domain is integers from 0 through 10, inclusive. Condition: ((x - 5) * (x - 5)) < 16. How many integers in this domain satisfy the condition?
Let x be a unitless number. Its domain is integers from 2 through 14, inclusive. Condition: ((x - 8) * (x - 8)) < 25. How many integers in this domain satisfy the condition?
